document.notes: Issued by the U.S. Railroad Retirement Board, not the IRS; the box layout reproduced here is the specimen printed in IRS Publication 915 (2025). RRB-1099 carries ONLY the social security equivalent benefit (SSEB) portion of tier 1. The NON-social-security-equivalent portion of tier 1, tier 2, vested dual benefits and supplemental annuities are reported on a different document, Form RRB-1099-R, which reaches 1040 lines 5a/5b and is governed by Pub. 575. Boxes 7, 8 and 9 are amounts paid for EARLIER years and are already inside box 3; they support the lump-sum election, they are not separately reportable.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader — which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model over the boxes this document declares. The 2025 face is VERIFIED against the Form RRB-1099 specimen in Pub. 915 (2025): all eleven captions match verbatim (spec 080 F-022). Unmeasured against a real page.
